title: Tracer diagnosis of dyspnoea: retrospective data analysis of prehospital emergency physician interventions from 2015-2023
summary:
Dyspnoea as a leading symptom is one of the most common indications in German emergency medical services.
Shortness of breath is an unpleasant and threatening sensation. Gasping for air is quickly accompanied by panic and fear of death, underlining the extent to which respiratory failure is a natural, basic bodily function. 
The term breathlessness is associated with a variety of conditions, including lung and airway diseases. Breathlessness can also be caused by cardiovascular disorders, psychological distress or metabolic disorders. Finding the right cause is therefore not always easy and often a challenge for emergency physicians. By comprehensively analysing a dataset of several thousand patients, it should be possible to identify the causes and potential triggers of the suspected diagnosis of 'dyspnoea', in order to improve the training and continuing education of emergency physicians.

interventions.name: All patients with a suspected diagnosis of acute dyspnoea in the emergency medical services of the Department of Anaesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine, University Hospital Ulm, Germany, in the years 2015-2023.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
All patients with a tracer diagnosis of dyspnoea
Exclusion criteria:
All patients with indications other than a tracer diagnosis of dyspnoea
